The '''Rooted Depths''' was the name given to a large cave on the northern edge of the [[Tangled Grove]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. During the [[Dread War]], a creature known as the [[Bothrium Beast]] made its home in the cave, but was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rooted Depths was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. It is the site of two faction-specific yet identical missions&mdash;"Scarred Paradise" for Imperial players and "Haunted Paradise" for Republic players&mdash;and the repeatable Daily version of that mission, "False Paradise."<ref name="TOR" />
